name: Leicester domestic and sexual abuse helpline
what_they_help_with: Specialist domestic/sexual abuse advice, safety planning, refuge access and professional referrals
volunteer_notes: Ask whether it is safe to speak or receive a callback. Do not leave revealing messages.

name: Zinthiya Trust
what_they_help_with: Domestic abuse, honour-based violence and FGM support; women and girls
volunteer_notes: Also helps with debt, benefits, food and energy hardship.

name: Leicester City Council — Homelessness Prevention
what_they_help_with: Housing assessment, prevention and emergency accommodation pathway
volunteer_notes: FIRST CONTACT for city homelessness and access to many hostel places. Ask about safety tonight.

name: Leicester City Council — Out-of-hours homelessness
what_they_help_with: Emergency homelessness contact outside office hours
volunteer_notes: Council pages publish differing out-of-hours routes; confirm current number before use.

name: Action Homeless — Duty Desk
what_they_help_with: Supported accommodation, emergency housing and Bridge House enquiries
how_to_refer: Most hostel placements via council; some direct enquiries
volunteer_notes: Duty desk Mon–Fri 9:30–4:30. Ask about current eligibility/vacancies. Do not promise a bed.

name: Action Homeless — Bridge House
what_they_help_with: Supported safe accommodation for women and children in housing crisis or fleeing abuse
how_to_refer: Ask duty desk for referral method
volunteer_notes: Do not publish confidential refuge locations. Consider domestic abuse helpline first.

name: Shelter — England emergency housing advice
what_they_help_with: Housing rights, eviction, homelessness and unsafe housing advice
volunteer_notes: Housing advice, NOT hostel accommodation; helpline Mon–Fri 8am–5pm.

name: Leicester Community Advice and Law Centre
what_they_help_with: Housing casework, rent/mortgage difficulties, debt and benefit appeals
address: Epic House, 1 Lower Hill Street, Leicester LE1 3SH
volunteer_notes: Advice opening hours may be restricted; check first.

name: The Bridge (East Midlands) — Housing services
what_they_help_with: Homelessness prevention and housing/tenancy support; some services age-limited
volunteer_notes: Some services focus on young people and county residents; check Leicester City eligibility.

name: NHS 111 — Mental Health Central Access Point
what_they_help_with: 24-hour urgent mental health assessment, advice and onward referral
volunteer_notes: For immediate danger to life call 999. Available all ages, 24/7.

name: Samaritans
what_they_help_with: Confidential emotional listening and support, including distress/suicidal thoughts
volunteer_notes: Listening service, not an emergency response service.

name: VitaMinds (NHS Talking Therapies)
what_they_help_with: Psychological therapies for anxiety, depression and related difficulties
volunteer_notes: Non-emergency support; ask about eligibility and current provider.

name: Leicester South Foodbank
what_they_help_with: Emergency food parcels through voucher/referral route
address: Community Hub, 40 Bell Street, Wigston LE18 1AD
volunteer_notes: Check catchment, distribution centre and opening times before directing service user.

name: Help through Hardship (Citizens Advice / Trussell)
what_they_help_with: Foodbank vouchers plus advice on benefits, income and grants
volunteer_notes: Can issue foodbank voucher where appropriate; useful first call for food crisis.

name: Open Hands — Food Store
what_they_help_with: Emergency food and low-cost social supermarket
volunteer_notes: Food Store currently lists Tue/Thu 10am–12pm; check who can act as referring agency.

name: Zinthiya Trust — Crisis and Welfare Support
what_they_help_with: Food, fuel, baby items, hygiene items, small grants and help with essential goods
volunteer_notes: Assistance depends on circumstances and funds.

name: Leicestershire Zakah Foundation
what_they_help_with: Local Muslim hardship, groceries, clothing, housing and education grants
volunteer_notes: IMPORTANT: Individual online applications currently CLOSED until further notice; ask about local partner route.

name: National Zakat Foundation
what_they_help_with: Zakat hardship grants, basic essentials, housing costs, empowerment grants
volunteer_notes: Eligibility applies; applicant needs email, mobile and internet. Funding is not immediate.

name: Citizens Advice LeicesterShire — Leicester City
what_they_help_with: Benefits, Universal Credit, debt, housing, employment and forms
how_to_refer: Phone first; appointments; emergency drop-in rules
volunteer_notes: Leicester CITY number. Mon–Fri 9am–4:30pm.

name: Leicester Community Advice and Law Centre
what_they_help_with: Welfare benefits, benefit appeals and tribunal representation
address: Epic House, 1 Lower Hill Street, Leicester LE1 3SH
volunteer_notes: Specialist advice; ask about current capacity.

name: Zinthiya Trust — Money and Energy Hub
what_they_help_with: Debt, budgeting, money and fuel poverty advice
volunteer_notes: Can also advise on essential household costs.

name: Leicester City Council — Crisis and Resilience Fund
what_they_help_with: Emergency help with costs, rent arrears and deposits (subject to eligibility)
volunteer_notes: Grant criteria and evidence vary; do not guarantee funds.

name: Leicester Community Advice and Law Centre
what_they_help_with: Specialist housing, debt, benefits and immigration legal advice
address: Epic House, 1 Lower Hill Street, Leicester LE1 3SH
volunteer_notes: Check whether they cover the specific legal issue and legal aid eligibility.

name: Citizens Advice LeicesterShire
what_they_help_with: General rights advice; signposting on employment, benefits, housing and family issues
volunteer_notes: Not a substitute for a regulated solicitor for specialist cases.

name: Turning Point — Leicester Drug and Alcohol Service
what_they_help_with: Drug/alcohol treatment, harm reduction, prescribing, recovery and naloxone
volunteer_notes: Provider lists 0300 number; NHS directory separately lists 0330. Check with service.

name: GamCare — National Gambling Helpline
what_they_help_with: Gambling problems, support for family, referrals to treatment
volunteer_notes: Free confidential support.

name: Juniper Lodge — Sexual Assault Referral Centre
what_they_help_with: Medical and forensic care, crisis support and sexual assault referrals (18+)
volunteer_notes: Current provider website number used (older directories show 0116 number). For immediate danger 999.

name: Leicester City of Sanctuary
what_they_help_with: Asylum/refugee community support, advice, English classes and signposting
volunteer_notes: Check drop-in details before attending.

name: Migrant Help — asylum support
what_they_help_with: Asylum system advice and practical guidance
volunteer_notes: May be relevant to asylum support; immigration legal advice requires accredited adviser.

name: Leicester Carers Support Service
what_they_help_with: Advice and wellbeing support for unpaid carers
address: Bradbury Centre, 46 Humberstone Gate, Leicester LE1 3PJ
volunteer_notes: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm.

name: Leicester Employment Hub
what_they_help_with: Jobs, careers, training, apprenticeships and barriers to work
volunteer_notes: Enquire about current employment programmes and eligibility.

name: Leicester City Council — Adult Social Care
what_they_help_with: Adult safeguarding concerns, care and support needs
volunteer_notes: Raise safeguarding concerns under organisational policy; 999 if immediate threat.

name: Leicester City Council — Children's Duty and Advice
what_they_help_with: Report concerns about a child's welfare or safety
volunteer_notes: Follow children's safeguarding procedure; do not delay urgent concerns.

name: Emergency services
what_they_help_with: Police, ambulance or fire in immediate danger or serious medical emergency
volunteer_notes: Includes suspected overdose, unconsciousness and immediate danger. Follow service protocols.

name: The Peace Centre — Peace Centre Foodbank
what_they_help_with: Emergency food parcels for individuals and families struggling to afford basic food.
address: The Peace Centre, Thurncourt Road, Leicester LE5 2NG
how_to_refer: To request registration, text NAME, ADDRESS and PHONE NUMBER to 07831 314 486 (do not call this mobile).
volunteer_notes: Official contact page lists Wednesday 10:30am–12pm. Confirm registration and parcel collection details first. Foodbank enquiries: 0116 241 7100; SMS 07831 311 614.

name: City Retreat & Move The Youth Foodbank
what_they_help_with: Weekly family food parcels for people facing financial hardship; community food support.
address: City Retreat, 74 Church Gate, Leicester LE1 4AL
how_to_refer: Contact City Retreat to confirm eligibility, parcel availability and whether registration or referral is needed.
volunteer_notes: Official programme advertises Fridays 4pm–5pm. Approximately 25 family parcels per week; limited supply. Do not promise a parcel without confirmation.
